how_to: فایل را به مترجم بده؛ خروجی را با نام fa-out-quest-orgrimmar-02-r2.json برگردان.
rules: به فارسی روان و معنادار ترجمه کن، نه آوانگاری؛ فقط نام خاص شخص/مکان آوانگاری می‌شود. هر ⟦...⟧ را دقیقاً همان‌طور و به تعداد اصلی نگه دار (جابه‌جایی در جمله مجاز است). عددها را حفظ کن (ارقام فارسی یا لاتین فرقی ندارد). ی و ک فارسی، نیم‌فاصله در «می‌»، «ها» و «ای». هیچ حرف لاتین در خروجی نباشد مگر داخل ⟦...⟧. از glossary برای واژه‌ها پیروی کن. خروجی فقط JSON: {"pack": <همین pack>, "fa": {"<کلید>": "ترجمه"}} با همهٔ کلیدهای rows، نه کم نه زیاد.
tokens_note: ⟦عدد⟧ = کد بازی (نام بازیکن، خط جدید، رنگ). ⟦E..⟧ = نام مصوب؛ معنی‌اش در entities است. هر دو را دست‌نخورده نگه دار.

rows.quest:7341:title: A Fair Trade
rows.quest:7341:progress:0: Greetings, ⟦8⟧. I am Kolark, Bounty ⟦E14⟧ from Thunderbluff. Much of the world I have traveled and much I have seen.⟦9⟧⟦10⟧My journeys across the South Seas led to the discovery of these wonderous thorium headed arrows. Alas, I have an endless supply of the arrows but have exhausted my supply of shells. Bah, no self respecting Tauren would ever be caught dead using a flimsy bow. The arrows are useless!⟦11⟧⟦12⟧I will offer a trade: An even exchange of thorium shells for my thorium headed arrows. Deal?
rows.quest:7341:completion:0: Excellent! I am a Tauren of my word, ⟦13⟧. The arrows are yours.
rows.quest:3504:details:0: Betraying, thieving woman! That's what I call her--that's all she'll ever be!
rows.quest:3504:details:1: I may have made a grave mistake, ⟦14⟧. I trusted a blood elf. What's worse, I trusted a woman!
rows.quest:3504:details:2: She claimed ⟦E18⟧ would hold great riches... powerful items. I simply send some warriors with her to protect her and I would be rewarded. Well, look who's the fool--she's killed them all.
rows.quest:3504:details:3: I want vengeance, ⟦15⟧, but I can't afford to send anyone else. Find Ag'tor at Valormok, north of the Haldarr Encampment. He'll tell you more.
rows.quest:3504:progress:0: Ah, Belgrom wizened up and finally sent someone not in his ranks to aid us, did he?⟦16⟧⟦17⟧This camp used to be a dozen warriors strong, ⟦18⟧, but now they're all dead. That mage, Rimtori, has slain them all. She played Belgrom like a lute... seduced him even. It's none of my business, but between you and I, she is quite the temptress. That's probably why I'm still out here helping Belgrom--I probably would have done the same thing.
rows.quest:3504:completion:0: We've sent everything we had at her and her workers, but they are strong in battle. None have bothered to return. I'm assuming some have died, but I'm sure others simply ran... cowards.
rows.quest:3504:completion:1: But now that reinforcements have arrived, perhaps there's still something we can do. Perhaps we can still punish her for lying and betraying Belgrom.
rows.quest:3504:completion:2: What do you say, are you in?
rows.quest:3505:obj:0: Kill 10 ⟦E20⟧ Elf Reclaimers, and 10 ⟦E20⟧ Elf Surveyors before seeking out ⟦E21⟧'s camp. Once you've found it, look for something that might be important to her that can be used to draw her into a fight.
rows.quest:3505:details:1: We start our crusade against her workers along the southern bluffs on the northern peninsula of ⟦E18⟧. Kill them with bloody rage--let them know they've betrayed the wrong allies.
rows.quest:3505:details:2: Do not concern yourself with her yet--she spends most of her time with her bodyguards searching ⟦E18⟧. It would be prudent after you've slain her workers to find her personal camp. Scouting out where we can attack her would be wise. Perhaps there is something there we can use to provoke her.
rows.quest:3505:progress:0: The title of the book is emblazoned on the black leather cover in gold leaf--⟦E23⟧. As you open the pages you can see that the book is very old but in superb condition.⟦19⟧⟦20⟧You assume the text is of some ancient language... perhaps Kaldorei?⟦21⟧⟦22⟧Your instincts tell you that you should return here once you've finished doling out retribution on the blood elves for their betrayal.
rows.quest:3505:completion:0: You begin to skim some of the pages until you come to a page that's marked by a thin, black strip of ⟦E24⟧ cloth.
rows.quest:3505:completion:1: As you try to decipher the script, you see a diagram on the bottom of one of the pages. A quick look around at the scene before you and you realize that the crystals, the circle, and even some of the other components on the ground are set up in a similar pattern as the diagram.
rows.quest:4494:details:0: It would seem that the silithid's intent, nay - reason for being, is to devour everything in their path that is not of their ecology. Their focus is singular, and it is for this reason they are a grave threat to all life on ⟦E27⟧.
rows.quest:4494:details:1: What we've seen to date is but the first stages. I suspect that their strength comes from deeper in ⟦E28⟧: ⟦E13⟧. Go to Gadgetzan in the ⟦E29⟧ desert and speak to ⟦E25⟧. Tell him of my theory; he will surely aid us in fighting the silithid.
rows.quest:4494:completion:0: Yes, I gathered that Zilzibin sent you to me. Your experience in fighting these beasties is priceless; no one to my knowledge has ever dealt with their kind before. As for Zil's idea that ⟦E13⟧ is their heart... perhaps it is. Un'Goro is a mysterious and dangerous jungle to the west of here. Perhaps it is also one step closer to figuring out what the silithid are all about.
rows.quest:4511:obj:0: Bring the ⟦E30⟧ to ⟦E31⟧ in the bank of ⟦E12⟧.
rows.quest:4511:details:0: ⟦23⟧, we could not have gotten this far without you. The time will come soon, no doubt, when I'll ask for your help against the silithid once more. We must absorb what we have learned in Un'Goro; I fear that my assumptions that the silithid originated from Un'Goro are now wrong... that indeed there is a far stronger presence somewhere.
rows.quest:4511:details:1: Take this note to ⟦E31⟧ at the bank. He'll give you something from my vault that should be viewed as a token of my gratitude. Thank you for your assistance, mighty ⟦24⟧.
